## Experienced leadership for the Piedmont community.
## Why I’m Running for City Council
For 20 years, Piedmont is where my family has laid down deep roots. As an active working mom, I haven't just lived here—I've rolled up my sleeves and gotten involved. I’ve volunteered in our classrooms, coached our youth sports teams, and raised my family alongside yours. I know this community because I am a part of its daily rhythm.
That same drive to be part of the community is what led me to step up as a leader for the League of Women Voters, to serve on the Piedmont Civil Service and Recreation Commissions, and now to run for City Council. I am also driven by a strong desire in public service, and for the past 27 years I have served as an attorney in the California Department of Justice working to protect the civil rights of all Californians. For the past three years I have been helping to shape our next generation of leaders by teaching law and public policy at the Goldman School of Public Policy at U.C. Berkeley. Keeping our city safe, our city amenities vibrant, and our infrastructure strong requires serious, proven leadership. I have spent years doing the groundwork and delivering results for our families on the local, statewide, and national level. I want to continue that work by taking a leadership role on the City Council and work with our dedicated City staff on the issues facing Piedmont including public safety, infrastructure, clean energy, and housing — all within the framework of an efficient and fiscally responsible agenda.
It is my goal to be an accessible, responsive Councilmember who collaborates with residents and colleagues alike to make thoughtful, proactive decisions that put Piedmont first. I am honored to have this collaborative approach endorsed by our Mayor, Piedmont’s entire City Council and School Board, State Senator Jesse Arreguín, former Police Chief Jeremy Bowers, nine former Piedmont Mayors, and a broad coalition of community leaders and neighbors.
I am eager to leverage my background in public service and public policy alongside my deep local connections to deliver equitable and experienced leadership for Piedmont, and I respectfully request your vote on Election Day.
Nancy's Priorities
## Public Safety
Nancy has worked on the front lines of public safety and civil rights to ensure our laws protect everyone equally. Nancy knows that community safety means more than having excellent police and fire departments – it also means investing in safe streets, well maintained infrastructure, emergency preparedness, and a strong connected community were residents look out for one another.
## Good Governance
Good governance means leading with integrity and clear purpose. Nancy is committed to fiscal responsibility—protecting taxpayer dollars while driving impactful public policy initiatives and community needs. True leadership demands fairness and transparent community engagement to ensure every voice in Piedmont is heard and valued, resulting in decisions that are best for Piedmont.
## Community & Sustainability
Piedmont’s continued excellence depends on strengthening our tight-knit community while thoughtfully planning for the future. Nancy is committed to responsibly meeting state housing mandates while ensuring Piedmont retains its hometown feel. As we invest in infrastructure, Nancy will continue to advocate for long-term environmental and financial sustainability.
Change doesn't happen without you, and every voice matters in shaping our community’s future. Whether you want to volunteer, host a neighborhood coffee, or simply stay updated on Nancy's vision, your support is what drives this campaign forward.
Join the growing list of Piedmont community members supporting Nancy for City Council—including every current member of the Piedmont City Council and School Board. Add your name and join neighbors across our community who believe Nancy’s experience, leadership, and commitment to Piedmont will make a difference on our City Council.
Join Us
Visit my News Q&A page to see what I’ve shared about the issues that matter to Piedmont, including letters to the editor, newspaper questionnaires, and other opportunities to share my perspectives with the community.

### Testimonials
Hear more from Nancy’s supporters and learn about what she’s saying in our local press!
Learn more
“I saw firsthand her ability to bring her legal and policy expertise to important and sometimes difficult issues while working constructively with law enforcement and the community.
“Nancy understands the importance of both public safety and strong community relationships. I believe her experience would be valuable on Piedmont’s City Council.”
–Jeremy Bowers Retired Piedmont Police Chief
Nancy brings the kind of experience and perspective that would strengthen our City Council. Her public service at the California Department of Justice, combined with her work as a UC Berkeley lecturer in law and public policy, Nancy understands government, policy, and the importance of thoughtful decision-making.
“Just as importantly, Nancy has been actively involved in the Piedmont community for decades. She has served on the Civil Service Commission, as President of the League of Women Voters of Piedmont, and currently as a Recreation Commissioner. She has also volunteered in our schools and youth sports as her high school boys have grown up in Piedmont.”
-Conna McCarthy
Vice-Mayor, City of Piedmont
“I worked for many years with Nancy at the California Department of Justice. Nancy dedicated over 25 years of her career to working at the DOJ and I saw firsthand how well she balanced multiple interests and priorities, while keeping her focus on improving the lives of California people.
“Nancy’s unwavering commitment to public service extends to our community. … As Nancy has already done for many years, she will bring thoughtful and principled leadership to the Council.”
–Tanya Koshy
Piedmont Resident
“Nancy and I worked closely together as volunteers with the League of Women Voters of Piedmont where she served as President. Her leadership, collaborative spirit, and support of our community are unwavering, not just with the League, but also through serving on multiple Piedmont Commissions. Her professional background as a supervising attorney at the California DOJ and lecturer at UC Berkeley make her exceedingly qualified and ready to work on the issues most important to Piedmont residents.”
–Lorrel Plimier
Piedmont City Council

## Join Us!
My entire career has been dedicated to public service, and running for City Council is the next step in my commitment to the community I love. I care deeply about our future, and I am ready to work hard every day to listen to your voice and deliver real results.
If elected, I will work collaboratively and in the best interests of all Piedmont residents, but I need your help. Every bit of support drives this campaign forward, and there are so many ways to help. Whether you choose to officially endorse this campaign, make a financial contribution of any size, display a yard sign, or show your support in any small way, your partnership matters.
